title: algorithm-crossover-atlas: code and data for "When Does a Theoretically Faster Algorithm Actually Win?"

creators.name: Paturu, Dhanush
creators.affiliation: Nitte Meenakshi Institute of Technology, Bengaluru, India

description: Benchmark harness, four algorithm-pair implementations (radix sort vs introsort, Strassen vs naive matrix multiplication, Karatsuba vs schoolbook multiplication, Fibonacci-heap vs binary-heap Dijkstra), randomized correctness tests, raw timing measurements, and the analysis pipeline that produces the crossover table and figures in the preprint of the same name.
